query: Which other Mexican Formula One race car driver has held the podium besides the Force India driver born in 1990?

retrieved_context: Sergio Pérez: Sergio Pérez Mendoza (    ; born 26 January 1990) also known as "Checo" Pérez, is a Mexican racing driver, currently driving for Force India.

Formula One drivers from Mexico: There have been six Formula One drivers from Mexico who have taken part in races since the championship began in 1950.  Pedro Rodríguez is the most successful Mexican driver being the only one to have won a grand prix.  Sergio Pérez, the only other Mexican to finish on the podium, currently races with Sahara Force India F1 Team .
